captions.text: Here's an arrow, one step to the right.
And another, one step straight up.
Each is exactly one square long.
We'll call them e one and e two.
Everything else will be built from these two.
What does the point three, two really mean?
Read the three as: stretch e one by three.
And the two says: stretch e two by two.
Now add them, tip to tail.
So v is exactly that sum.
Three, two is three e one plus two e two.
Coordinates aren't just labels on a point.
They're instructions: stretch, stretch, then add.
